fields.FIR_Description: A oral complaint dated 2025-12-21 states that the owner of Kalai Home Appliances reported repeated demands for weekly payments of Rs. 1,500 from persons visiting the premises near Anbu Park Main Street, on 2025-12-21 at about 20:45. Thirumal Babu reported the matter orally at Trichy Central PS; the contact number given was 9000000321. The complainant is associated with the business Kalai Home Appliances. Vasanth Chandran (9000000408) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. The complainant alleged that Murugan Karuppasamy may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000309. Potentially relevant material referenced includes a witness statement and CCTV footage. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00246, as the mobile number 9000000309 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspects allegedly visited the premises and demanded regular payments.
fields.Keywords: extortion, business, witness statement, mobile number, evening, CCTV, suspect, witness
